queue.title: Trucker sentenced in $7.2 million cargo theft scheme involving legitimate freight contracts
queue.excerpt: A California trucking company owner received 30 months in federal prison for participating in a $7.2 million cargo theft scheme. Criminals used legitimate transportation contracts to obtain shipments before diverting merchandise from warehouses across Southern California.

queue.title: Nvidia gets more supplier capacity to meet AI demand
queue.excerpt: The chipmaker unveiled the latest production agreements a month after securing other deals from partners.

queue.title: The $1bn parking question – STB says railroads can charge even when cars and land are private
queue.excerpt: Under the radar: CSX and Norfolk Southern collected nearly $1 billion in annual demurrage revenue in 2021. And now a federal ruling has reinforced their authority to charge for private railcars held at a Pennsylvania industrial park, following a dispute that produced a $354,000 court judgment.

queue.title: Trucking groups praise Labor Department’s flip of independent contractor rule
queue.excerpt: The shift back to a weighted review of circumstances returns “clarity and order to the law in this area,” the American Trucking Associations said.
